honors.title: Computerworld 2012 Best of BI
honors.description:
I was a primary member of the team which developed an award-winning data warehouse, which was recognized by Computerworld. Our photo appeared in the August 2012 issue.

"The team integrated 14 data sources, including campaign management, general ledger, point-of-sale and casino-specific player tracking and slot floor systems. All of the data had to be cleaned and audited, so the team members created an automated process for staging, cleaning and analyzing the data for errors before loading it into the data warehouse. They then built multiple dashboards for a variety of business concerns, starting with direct-mail reporting and analysis."

http://www.computerworld.com/article/2489535/enterprise-applications/best-of-bi--seminole-gaming-boosts-bottom-line-by-millions-with-bi.html

honors.title: TDWI Best Practices Award Winners 2012 (Advanced Analytics)
honors.description:
I was a primary member of the team which developed an award-winning data warehouse, which was recognized by TDWI.

"This team has helped the company operators leverage analytics in a way that drives tens of millions of dollars to the company’s bottom line.

The foundation of the company’s advanced analytics tool is a “big data” data warehouse that takes in 14 source systems to provide 360-degree views of both the customer and the business. "

http://tdwi.org/pages/best-practices-awards/winners/tdwi-best-practices-awards-2012-winners/tdwi-best-practices-awards-2012-winner-summaries.aspx
honors.issuer: Issued by The Data Warehousing Institute · Aug 2012
